# darkniche

**Documentation site:** <https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/>

**Which species are absent from a region although its climate is inside
their tolerance?** `darkniche` answers that question end to end — and
makes the two ways of getting the answer wrong visible in the output
instead of hidden in a footnote.

## The problem

Climatic dark diversity is the set of species a region could hold but
does not. Measuring it requires answering a *containment* question — is
this region’s climate inside this species’ niche? — but the statistics
the field uses for niche comparison, Schoener’s *D* and Warren’s *I*,
are **symmetric measures of similarity**. They penalise niche mass lying
outside the region, so a broad-niched species scores near zero against a
small region it could trivially occupy, for the very trait that makes
generalists successful colonisers.

The problem is structural, not a matter of tuning: over unit-mass
densities the min-overlap functional is *identically* Schoener’s *D*, so
no symmetric statistic can express containment. `darkniche` asserts that
identity in its own test suite.

![engine](analysis/figures/fig2_engine.png)

engine

In a controlled simulation where admissibility is known from the
generating geometry — never from any evaluated statistic — directional
coverage recovers it at **AUC 0.997 against 0.882 for Schoener’s *D***
(paired DeLong z = 28.1). Thresholded at its own optimum, *D*
over-estimates the size of the admissible pool by **215%**; DNC_q errs
by 21%.

## The diagnostic

The standard region-level test — count species above a similarity
threshold, compare with a null expectation — reverses its verdict with
the choice of threshold. On the bundled results for all 619 terrestrial
ecoregions: **71 ecoregions look enriched at the 80th percentile of the
coverage distribution and 449 at the 99th**, and 439 of the 452 reliably
testable ecoregions (97%) change direction somewhere in between.

![sweep](analysis/figures/fig5_sweep.png)

sweep

[`dn_sweep()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_sweep.md)
returns a classed object that says so when you print it — computed only
from thresholds the test itself considers reliable.

## Install

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ehsanrahimi666/darkniche")
```

Not on CRAN — install from GitHub. No hard dependencies beyond base R,
so nothing else needs compiling. To build the vignette as well:

``` r

remotes::install_github("ehsanrahimi666/darkniche", build_vignettes = TRUE)
vignette("darkniche-quickstart")
```

### Check the install worked

Copy-paste this into a fresh R session. Every printed value should match
the comment beside it.

``` r

library(darkniche)
set.seed(1)

# 1. the bundled global results load, and reproduce the published summary
eco <- dn_data("ecoregion")
nrow(eco)                                    #> 619
round(range(eco$cddr), 3)                    #> 0.022 0.924
round(cor(eco$cddr, log10(eco$area_km2)), 3) #> -0.441

# 2. the algebraic identity the package rests on: no symmetric statistic can
#    express containment, because sum(min(Zs, Ze)) IS Schoener's D
sp <- dn_space(cbind(rnorm(3000), rnorm(3000)), R = 60)
Zs <- rbind(as.numeric(dn_density(cbind(rnorm(800, 0, 1.4),
                                        rnorm(800, 0, 1.4)), sp)))
Ze <- rbind(as.numeric(dn_density(cbind(rnorm(300, 0, 0.25),
                                        rnorm(300, 0, 0.25)), sp)))
m <- dn_metrics(Zs, Ze)
all.equal(as.numeric(m$DNC_min), as.numeric(m$D))   #> TRUE
round(c(D = m$D, DNC_q = m$DNC_q, DNC_auc = m$DNC_auc), 3)
#>       D   DNC_q DNC_auc
#>   0.149   1.000   0.730
# D is low although the region is habitable throughout; only the directional
# forms say so.

# 3. the diagnostic fires on the real data
dn_direction_census(dn_data("sweep"))$census
#>   quantile n_enriched n_depleted
#> 1     0.80         71        548
#> 2     0.90        344        275
#> 3     0.95        520         81
#> 4     0.99        449          3
```

### Run the package’s own test suite

R does not install a package’s tests by default, so this needs one extra
install flag:

``` r

remotes::install_github("ehsanrahimi666/darkniche",
                        INSTALL_opts = "--install-tests")
testthat::test_package("darkniche")
#> [ FAIL 0 | WARN 0 | SKIP 0 | PASS 162 ]
```

## Use

``` r

library(darkniche)

# --- the published global results ship with the package --------------------
eco <- dn_data("ecoregion")          # 619 ecoregions
rep <- dn_report(eco, dn_data("sweep"))
rep
#> Climatic dark-diversity report
#>   regions: 619
#>   CDDR: 0.022 - 0.924 (median 0.579)
#>   area confound: r = -0.441 -- rank on the residual, never on raw CDDR
#>   286 regions move more than 10% of the ranking when area is removed
#>   threshold sweep: 439 of 452 regions (97%) change direction
#>   ** a single-threshold enrichment claim is not supportable here **

# --- or run the workflow on your own data ----------------------------------
sp <- dn_space(global_scores, R = 100)        # one lattice for everything
Zs <- dn_density(species_scores, sp)          # one density per species
Ze <- dn_density(region_scores, sp)           # one density per region

m <- dn_metrics(rbind(as.numeric(Zs)), rbind(as.numeric(Ze)))
nul <- dn_null_shift(Zs, rbind(as.numeric(Ze)), dn_density(global_scores, sp))
dn_null_summary(m$DNC_auc, nul)

pairs <- dn_dark(pair_table, p_min = 0.177, ses_cols = c("n1_ses", "n2_ses"))
cddr  <- dn_cddr(n_dark, n_present, area)     # raw ratio AND area residual

# BEFORE reporting any enrichment result:
sw <- dn_sweep(obs_coverage, null_mean, null_sd)
sw; plot(sw)
```

## What it answers

| Question | Function |
|----|----|
| Could this species live in this region, given its climate? | [`dn_metrics()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_metrics.md) |
| Is that more than a species of its niche breadth achieves anyway? | [`dn_null_breadth()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_breadth.md) |
| Does the result need the niche to sit where it does? | [`dn_null_shift()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_shift.md) |
| Does it need the range to occupy the geography it does? | [`dn_null_relocate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_relocate.md) |
| What coverage value should count as “admissible”? | [`dn_match()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_match.md), [`dn_calibrate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_calibrate.md) |
| Does directional coverage beat niche similarity at predicting establishment? | [`dn_auc()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_auc.md), [`dn_delong()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_delong.md) |
| Which species are absent although the region is admissible? | [`dn_dark()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_dark.md) |
| Which regions hold the largest unrealised pools? | [`dn_cddr()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_cddr.md), [`dn_report()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_report.md) |
| Does this region hold more admissible species than chance allows? | [`dn_aggregate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_aggregate.md) |
| Is that answer a property of the region, or of my threshold? | [`dn_sweep()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_sweep.md) |

## Functions

| Function | Purpose |
|----|----|
| [`dn_space()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_space.md), [`dn_density()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_density.md), [`dn_moments()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_moments.md) | shared lattice; fixed-bandwidth kernel densities; niche moments |
| [`dn_envelope()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_envelope.md), [`dn_entryq()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_entryq.md), [`dn_weights()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_weights.md) | q-envelopes, cumulative density rank, coverage weight vectors |
| [`dn_metrics()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_metrics.md) | DNC_q, DNC_auc, NSI_q, CFI, CFI_w, NOV + Schoener’s *D*, Warren’s *I*, BC |
| [`dn_null_breadth()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_breadth.md), [`dn_null_shift()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_shift.md), [`dn_null_relocate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_relocate.md) | N1 breadth-matched, N2 environmental shift, N3 geographic relocation |
| [`dn_ses()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_ses.md), [`dn_null_summary()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_summary.md) | standardised effect sizes with a floored null SD |
| [`dn_match()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_match.md), [`dn_auc()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_auc.md), [`dn_delong()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_delong.md), [`dn_calibrate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_calibrate.md) | matched negatives, DeLong AUC and paired tests, Youden calibration |
| [`dn_dark()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_dark.md), [`dn_cddr()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_cddr.md), [`dn_report()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_report.md) | conjunction rule, area-adjusted ratio, one-call region report |
| [`dn_aggregate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_aggregate.md), [`dn_sweep()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_sweep.md), [`dn_direction_census()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_direction_census.md) | region-level test with reliability flags; the threshold-sweep diagnostic |
| [`dn_data()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_data.md) | bundled results for all 619 terrestrial ecoregions |
| `dn_plot_*()` (7) | containment demo, densities, CDDR–area, matrices, sources, ROC, sweeps |
| [`dn_table_extremes()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_table_extremes.md), [`dn_table_export()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_table_export.md) | paper tables; CSV / Markdown / LaTeX |

## Guardrails you cannot switch off

- [`dn_aggregate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_aggregate.md)
  returns `NA` for the effect size, p-value and enrichment whenever the
  expected count is below 5 — a 2,000-fold ratio against an expectation
  of 0.001 species is arithmetic, not evidence.
- [`dn_cddr()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_cddr.md)
  returns the area-adjusted residual beside the raw ratio and documents
  that raw CDDR must never rank regions.
- [`dn_sweep()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_sweep.md)
  prints its reversal warning from the object itself, so it survives
  into any report that prints the result.

## Data

The package ships **no** range polygons, ecoregion shapefiles or climate
rasters — those are your inputs (IUCN, BirdLife, WWF, WorldClim; all
freely downloadable, too large and licence-restricted to bundle). What
it does ship is the **published output** of the global analysis: 619
ecoregions, 35,087 species, 21,718,853 evaluated pairs, so every example
and test runs on real results.

## Correctness

162 unit tests. 56 of them verify the numerical core against fixtures
generated by an independent Python implementation: kernel density
estimation to within 2e-7 of `scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter`, all twelve
metrics to within 5e-6, envelopes and the aggregate test exactly, the
environmental-shift null exactly under injected targets. The remaining
106 test behaviour — including that the sweep’s verdict never uses cells
the test calls unreliable.

`R CMD check` passes clean; CI runs on Linux, Windows and macOS.

  site

  — worked tutorial

- `manuscript/darkniche_MEE_manuscript.docx` — the software paper
- `analysis/` — scripts regenerating every figure and table in the paper
- `DESIGN.md` — architecture and porting notes

## Reproducing the paper

``` bash
Rscript analysis/01_simulation.R    # controlled simulation, Fig. 3, Table 4
Rscript analysis/02_ecoregions.R    # 619 ecoregions, Figs. 4-5, Table 5
Rscript analysis/03_schematics.R    # Figs. 1-2
```

# Package index

## Environmental space

One shared lattice, one density per object.

- [`dn_space()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_space.md)
  : Define a shared environmental-space lattice
- [`dn_centres()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_centres.md)
  : Lattice cell centres
- [`dn_density()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_density.md)
  : Kernel density of a point set on the lattice
- [`dn_moments()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_moments.md)
  : First and second moments of a lattice density

## Coverage geometry

Envelopes, cumulative density rank, and the coverage weight vectors.

- [`dn_envelope()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_envelope.md)
  : q-quantile niche envelope
- [`dn_entryq()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_entryq.md)
  : Entry quantile of every lattice cell
- [`dn_weights()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_weights.md)
  : Coverage weight vector for one species

## Metrics

The directional family, with the symmetric statistics computed alongside
for comparison.

- [`dn_metrics()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_metrics.md)
  : All pairwise niche metrics for a block of species and regions

## Null models

Three ways of asking whether a coverage value is more than chance.

- [`dn_null_breadth()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_breadth.md)
  : Breadth-matched null (N1)
- [`dn_null_shift()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_shift.md)
  : Environmental-shift null (N2)
- [`dn_null_relocate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_relocate.md)
  : Geographic relocation null (N3)
- [`dn_null_summary()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_null_summary.md)
  : Summarise a null matrix
- [`dn_ses()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_ses.md)
  : Standardised effect size with a floored null SD

## Calibration

Fixing what “admissible” means, against documented introductions.

- [`dn_match()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_match.md)
  : Realm- and area-matched negatives for introduced-range validation
- [`dn_auc()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_auc.md)
  : AUC with DeLong variance (fast algorithm of Sun & Xu 2014)
- [`dn_delong()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_delong.md)
  : Paired DeLong test between two correlated AUCs
- [`dn_calibrate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_calibrate.md)
  : Calibrate the admissibility threshold (Youden)

## Dark-diversity accounting

The conjunction rule and the area-adjusted ratio.

- [`dn_dark()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_dark.md)
  : Dark-diversity classification of species-region pairs
- [`dn_cddr()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_cddr.md)
  : Climatic dark-diversity ratio and its area adjustment

## Region-level inference and its diagnostic

The Poisson-binomial count test with reliability flags, and the
threshold sweep that shows when its direction is an artefact.

- [`dn_aggregate()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_aggregate.md)
  : Region-level aggregate admissibility test (single threshold)
- [`dn_sweep()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_sweep.md)
  : Threshold-sweep diagnostic for the aggregate null test
- [`dn_direction_census()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_direction_census.md)
  : Direction census of an aggregate null test across thresholds
- [`dn_report()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_report.md)
  : One-call region report

## Data

- [`dn_data()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_data.md)
  : Load bundled ecoregion example data

## Figures and tables

- [`dn_plot_cddr_area()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_plot_cddr_area.md)
  : CDDR against area with the confound displayed (papers' Figure 7
  style)
- [`dn_plot_containment()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_plot_containment.md)
  : Conceptual containment figure (papers' Figure 1)
- [`dn_plot_density()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_plot_density.md)
  : Plot a density in environmental space
- [`dn_plot_matrix()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_plot_matrix.md)
  : Region-by-taxon matrix heatmap (papers' Figure 9 style)
- [`dn_plot_roc()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_plot_roc.md)
  : ROC curves for metric comparison (papers' Figure 3 style)
- [`dn_plot_sources()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_plot_sources.md)
  : Stacked source-decomposition bars (papers' Figure 11 style)
- [`dn_plot_sweeps()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_plot_sweeps.md)
  : Multi-region threshold-sweep figure (papers' Figure 10 style)
- [`dn_table_extremes()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_table_extremes.md)
  : Extremes table (papers' Table 6 style)
- [`dn_table_export()`](https://ehsanrahimi666.github.io/darkniche/reference/dn_table_export.md)
  : Export a table as CSV, Markdown or LaTeX
